The '''Aphran system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] that was located within the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. The system contained the [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Aphran IV]], and was centered around the [[Star/Legends|star]], [[Aphran]].
